display_name: UVISA 2.0 全栈项目 (前端 + 后端整体)

project_identity.description: UVISA 2.0 是一个前后端一体化项目，不是两个独立项目。前端(React SPA)和后端(Spring Boot API)共享同一个产品目标、同一份 PRD、同一套验收标准。任何 Lark 任务的改动都必须从前端→后端→契约全链路考虑，禁止只改前端不管后端或只给空壳接口不填实现。
project_identity.single_project_rule: 前后端是一个项目的两个模块，不是一个项目调用另一个项目的 API。任务分类时优先使用 fullstack-integrated，只有纯 UI 样式/纯后端批处理才分别归类为 frontend-only / backend-only。

tech_stack.backend: Java 21 Spring Boot multi-module Maven (api-public / api-admin / domain / platform / integration)

fullstack_domain_map._description: 前端页面 → 后端服务/Controller 的映射关系。每个域的改动都必须同时检查前端 service/store/screen 和后端 controller/service/domain。

conventions: UVISA 2.0 是前后端一体化项目。前端和后端共享产品目标，不是两个独立项目。
Before product/UI/architecture/test claims, read AGENTS.md and Workpad section 12 boot capsule.
Do not delete features, routes, buttons, or displayed fields to make dead UI disappear.
Do not use mock success to hide real-backend drift.
后端修改必须完整落地：Controller + Service + Domain/Repository + 测试，禁止只写空壳 Controller 而不实现业务逻辑。
Lark 任务默认是 fullstack-integrated：前后端同时修改，同时验证。只有明确是纯 UI 样式或纯后端批处理才分别归类。
后端代码可写；如果多模型分析认为后端是正确的修复点，直接编辑后端代码，用 TDD，单独 commit。
前后端 commit 按 repo 分开；默认本地 commit，用户明确要求时才 push 前端。
Project test credentials, OTP values, Railway session details, and secrets stay only in project Workpad/runtime evidence, never in global memory or public docs.

backend_complete_landing_policy._rationale: 过去存在后端只写 Controller 空壳、不填 Service/Domain 实现的问题。此策略要求后端修改必须全链路落地。
backend_complete_landing_policy.definition: 后端完整落地 = Controller 入口 → Service 业务逻辑 → Domain/Repository 数据层 → 单元/集成测试 → 编译通过
required_layers: Controller: 定义 API 端点、请求/响应 DTO、权限注解
Service: 实现业务逻辑，包含校验、状态流转、异常处理
Domain/Repository: 数据实体、持久化、查询方法
测试: 至少一个覆盖核心路径的 JUnit 测试
forbidden_patterns: Controller 方法返回 null / 空集合 / 硬编码 mock 值而无 TODO+issue 跟踪
Service 方法体为空或只有一行 return
新增 Entity/DTO 但无对应的 Repository 或 Service 使用
声称 API 已就绪但实际只有 HTTP 200 + 空 body
backend_complete_landing_policy.verification: 编译通过(mvn compile) + 至少一个测试通过(mvn test -Dtest=XxxTest) + curl/Playwright 验证端点返回真实数据结构

backend_contract_policy.rationale: Many backend APIs are still missing, incomplete, or contract-drifted; frontend-only regression can miss these failures.
must_scan_backend_when: The task touches authentication, OTP, PIN/payment password, 2FA, device/session security, KYC, card, wallet, topup, exchange, remittance, notification, account/profile, or any money/status/time/order field.
The frontend uses a mock, compatibility alias, fallback, placeholder, hardcoded success, or a TODO around an API.
The PRD/product logic depends on backend source-of-truth semantics rather than pure display text/style.
required_analysis: Read frontend service/store/screen path AND the corresponding backend controller/service/domain/repository path.
Verify canonical vs legacy endpoint shapes, auth requirements, envelope shape, field naming, state transitions, and error semantics.
If backend is incomplete or unsafe, do not close by frontend shim alone; implement backend full-stack fix (Controller→Service→Domain→Test) or record explicit backend blocker/follow-up.

regression_coverage_policy.frontend_unit_and_build: Covers component/service mapping, i18n, local guards, type/build regressions; does not prove real backend correctness.
regression_coverage_policy.mock_server_or_fixture_tests: Only covers expected contract fixtures; cannot certify real backend endpoints or business state transitions.
regression_coverage_policy.playwright_with_live_or_local_backend: Can expose route/auth/envelope/field/backend runtime errors and is required for cross-stack product acceptance when backend semantics matter.
regression_coverage_policy.backend_compile_and_targeted_tests: Required when backend code is changed; use openjdk@21 and targeted module tests first, then compile/package as feasible.
regression_coverage_policy.closeout_rule: Task completion claims must distinguish UI regression PASS, product logic PASS, backend contract PASS, and deployment/build monitoring PASS.

acceptance: pnpm test and pnpm run build pass after frontend changes unless a pre-existing blocker is explicitly evidenced.
Backend-related tasks include backend source inspection and, if changed, full-stack landing (Controller→Service→Domain→Test) plus compile/package evidence using openjdk@21.
后端修改必须完整落地：不允许只有 Controller 没有 Service 实现。每一层都必须有真实业务逻辑。
For cross-stack changes, browser/Playwright acceptance uses local frontend connected to local real backend or a clearly labeled live/test backend; mock is comparison only.
PRD/product logic claims are written to PRODUCT_USER_LOGIC_TEST_CASES.md; page/UI/function claims are written to UI_TEST_CASES.md.
After frontend changes requested for Lark closeout, push frontend code and monitor the remote frontend package/build status to success/healthy or record an explicit blocker.
Backend deployment status is not required for this user's current UVISA frontend-task closeout unless the user explicitly asks for backend deploy verification.
forbidden: Claiming a task done from frontend unit/build alone when backend semantics are involved.
Masking backend missing APIs with mock success or silent frontend fallback without documenting the backend owner/blocker.
后端只写 Controller 空壳，不实现 Service/Domain 业务逻辑。
后端 API 声称就绪但实际返回 null/空/硬编码 mock，无 TODO+issue 跟踪。
将前后端当作两个独立项目分别处理，忽略全链路验证。
Treating Railway/staging as a substitute for deterministic local tests.
Recording OTPs, tokens, cookies, or credentials in repo docs, global memory, TG messages, or public artifacts.
Pushing backend deploy expectations for this workflow when the user only asked to monitor frontend remote build.

multi_model_policy.task_solution: For each Lark task, prepare an evidence bundle that includes frontend, backend, PRD/product docs, UI/product ledgers, and ADRs as applicable.
multi_model_policy.full_certification_rule: Full certification requires all four expected models to participate and no unresolved severity>=3 blockers; planner quorum without discussion_result is advisory only.

local_fullstack_browser_acceptance.purpose: Use browser/Playwright to validate frontend and backend together by running local frontend through a real local backend, not mock-server.

default_topology.backend: Spring Boot app on http://localhost:8080 (verify /actuator/health before UI claims)
default_topology.frontend: Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173 with /api proxied to backend via VITE_DEV_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:8080
default_topology.api_base_rule: Keep VITE_API_BASE unset for local proxy mode, or set it explicitly only when CORS is confirmed; proxy mode avoids browser CORS noise.

required_steps: Capture git status/log in both frontend and backend repos.
Start backend dependencies, then backend app with openjdk@21; verify health and exact service paths with curl before browser claims.
Start frontend with VITE_DEV_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:8080 pnpm run dev -- --host localhost.
Use browser/Playwright at http://localhost:5173 to operate the real user flow; inspect console/network/storage and redact sensitive OTP/token data.
Classify findings by owner: frontend, backend, test seed/config, or product/PRD ambiguity.
If backend code changed, run backend targeted tests/compile; if frontend changed, run frontend targeted/full tests and build.
Record evidence paths in UI_TEST_CASES.md / PRODUCT_USER_LOGIC_TEST_CASES.md / Workpad as applicable.
not_a_substitute_for: Backend targeted tests after backend code changes
Remote frontend build monitoring after pushed frontend changes

lark_task_execution_policy.primary_goal: Complete the assigned Lark task acceptance with fullstack coverage, not run an open-ended product/backend audit.
lark_task_execution_policy.optimization_rule: Choose the best safe solution within project red lines, but keep implementation and verification tightly aligned with the concrete Lark task requirement.
classification_required: backend-only (纯后端批处理/定时任务/基础设施)
lark_task_execution_policy.fullstack_landing_rule: Lark 任务默认按 fullstack-integrated 执行：前端 service/store/screen + 后端 controller/service/domain 同时修改，同时验证。禁止只改前端不管后端。
lark_task_execution_policy.backend_task_classification: For tasks involving backend semantics or missing/problematic APIs, multi-model analysis must classify whether the correct landing point is backend, frontend, or cross-stack before implementation.
verification_focus: Task-specific acceptance path from Lark description/comments/docs/prototype.
No feature/field/precision loss while satisfying the task.
Backend inspection/fix only to the depth needed for the task acceptance and safety red lines.
Local deterministic evidence first; multi-model ratification validates direction/blockers rather than expanding scope endlessly.
PUA-loop continues until task acceptance, deterministic gates, required multi-model gate, scoped commit/push/remote-frontend-build/TG closeout are complete.
scope_control: Do not let backend-aware testing become broad backend modernization unless the task or multi-model blocker requires it.
If a discovered backend defect is outside task acceptance, record it as follow-up unless it blocks or endangers the current task.
If Lark task and broader PRD/product docs conflict, prefer the explicit Lark task for this delivery and record the conflict.
